description:
The proposal seeks planning permission for a single-storey garden room within the rear garden of the Property, alongside associated landscaping and level adjustments to integrate the structure and improve the garden’s overall usability.

The garden room has been positioned to the rear of the site and partially set into the landscape to minimise its visual impact. It is intended to form part of the wider garden composition, rather than read as a prominent standalone structure.

The surrounding landscaping, including planting, retaining walls and stepped external spaces, has been designed to soften the appearance of the building, reduce its perceived bulk and help it sit comfortably within the garden setting.
